sn2.4:1.2: The god “of Magadha”. Deities tend to be attached to places rather than political entities, and we meet no such deity elsewhere. Given that the Sutta follows the godling Māgha, and that PTS notes Māgha as a variant of this name in Sinhala manuscripts, perhaps this is a misspelling of Maghada, “giver of bounty”, cf. _maghadeya_ at Rig Veda 7.67.9.
